mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use rustls as the TLS backend, chosen because it is a pure Rust implementation. Certificate verification stays enabled in every build, development builds included, and HTTPS is enforced everywhere with no plaintext exception, even for internal services.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md
